title: Screen-Before-Bed Overage by App Category
dataSources: Alcohol habit events (`habit:alcohol`), caffeine intake (`habit:caffeine`), screen-time sessions (`habit:screen`), and fasting windows (`habit:fasting`).
app: Habit-boundary telemetry for Dry January, caffeine cutoffs, screen-before-bed limits, and fasting windows sent to Splunk HEC via apps, shortcuts, and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=habit:screen
| search bed_window=true overage_min>0
| bin _time span=1d
| stats sum(overage_min) as overage_min by _time app_category
| sort - _time
description: Tracks screen-before-bed overage over time and breaks it out by app category.
value: App-category overage tells you whether the last-hour leak is mainly social, video, or gaming.
implementation: Send screen-before-bed overage events to `index=personal` with the fields used in the breakdown and review the resulting trend at 1d granularity.
visualization: Stacked time chart of screen-before-bed overage by app category.
grandmaExplanation: It totals how screen-before-bed overage changes over time so the busy spells and quiet spells stand out.
